description: This file defines a set of React components for a dropdown menu UI, utilizing Radix UI primitives and lucide icons, with utility functions for styling and component composition.

methods.name: DropdownMenuSubTrigger
methods.description: A React component for the submenu trigger, with optional inset styling.

methods.name: DropdownMenuSubContent
methods.description: A React component for the submenu content, with animated and styled container.

methods.name: DropdownMenuContent
methods.description: A React component for the main dropdown content, with portal rendering and styling.

methods.name: DropdownMenuItem
methods.description: A React component for individual dropdown items.

methods.name: DropdownMenuCheckboxItem
methods.description: A React component for checkbox items within the dropdown.

methods.name: DropdownMenuRadioItem
methods.description: A React component for radio button items within the dropdown.

methods.name: DropdownMenuLabel
methods.description: A React component for labeling groups of dropdown items.

methods.name: DropdownMenuSeparator
methods.description: A React component for visual separation between dropdown items.

methods.name: DropdownMenuShortcut
methods.description: A component for displaying shortcut hints in the menu.
